newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE A shares fell and B shares were steady on Monday on sharply higher turnover on the Beirut Stock exchange (BSE).
A shares fell 3.85 percent to $109.125 from Friday's $113.5, and B shares remained steady at $113.
Dealers said the A shares fell mainly because of the lack of demand.
"There was a big offer on low price on A shares that did not match with a big demand so the prices went down. If this situation continues, A shares will continue to go down," a broker said.
Turnover nearly doubled to 12,633 shares from Friday's 6,360, and the value of traded shares was $1,392,923.625 from $711,612.5.
There was no trade in the shares of the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index was down 0.56 percent to 83.56 and the BLOM stock index was also down 1.52 percent to 952.01.
